source_locations.location: Main text, discussion of 1 and Figure 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Eight samarium units form a bowl-shaped octamer. Dipyrrolide ligands bridge adjacent Sm atoms through π- and σ-bound pyrrole rings. Four chlorides within the cavity each bridge three Sm atoms and surround a nearly coplanar central Li atom. The dianionic cluster is formally composed of seven Sm(II) and one Sm(III) centers, with separate lithium-containing counterions.

synthesis.procedure: A THF solution of the dilithium salt of the diphenyldipyrromethanyl dianion was treated with an equivalent amount of SmCl3(THF)3, then reduced with metallic lithium under Ar to give dark-brown 1. The main text does not report a numerical reagent amount.

reagents.name: Dilithium salt of the diphenyldipyrromethanyl dianion

reagents.amount: Equivalent amount; no numerical quantity reported
reagents.name: Samarium trichloride THF adduct

synthesis.yield: Good yield; no numerical value reported

source_locations.location: Main text, discussion of 2 and Figure 2

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A monoanionic samarium octamer structurally similar to 1, with sodium rather than lithium at the center of the chloride-containing cluster. It contains six Sm(II) and two Sm(III) centers and has a separate [Na(THF)5]+ counterion.

synthesis.procedure: A reduction analogous to that used for 1 was carried out under Ar with sodium instead of lithium. A deep-green solution yielded dark-green crystals of 2. The main text gives no numerical reagent amount.

reagents.name: Dilithium salt of the diphenyldipyrromethanyl dianion
reagents.role: Ligand precursor in the analogous preparation

reagents.name: Samarium trichloride THF adduct
